title: P104: sharp upward rank floor and an all-input chart-531 relay repair
body:
## Mathematical result
Every deterministic fixed-schedule normalized binary protocol with these 630 public chart bindings needs at least 4,750 upward rank units. The original word attains all eight dimension-cut ranks. A dual weighting gives the exact relaxed powered price. The proposed 326 → 531 → 1 shortcut on unchanged incidences loses one independent bit, even with nonlinear local recoding. An explicit three-contact repair restores every output and the transpose. For one substitution its raw margin at κ = 0.00389046 is −1.121935400785230928… . Five private clear records change. A physical erasure and signed application for the altered word are open.

The registered replay passed in 3.14 s and in 2.90 s on a clean committed export. It verifies the 630×630 forward and transpose actions, all eight cuts, the joint-copy obstruction, retained endpoint charges, and rejects damaged source, receipts, missing-ADD and wrong-oracle controls. This supplies an independently rerunnable normalized binary result. The five original P104 application premises still govern complete multiplication.
